$comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for DEXI-5 flight-controller parameters. The .params files in dexi-5/ are GENERATED from this file by tools/gen-params.mjs. Never hand-edit them. Values sit on top of PX4's 4601_droneblocks_dexi_5 airframe defaults and list only what differs from them.
name: DEXI-5

boardDefaults.$comment: Nothing yet: the 4601 airframe already sets ports and RC input for the ARK Pi6X.

imu-cal.doc: Keep the bench calibration. PX4's default SENS_IMU_AUTOCAL 1 saves the EKF's learned accel/gyro bias over it on disarm; on this DEXI-5 that moved ACC0 Y -0.046 -> -0.429 -> -0.111 m/s^2 across five saves in three days (2026-10-16..19).

params.name: SENS_IMU_AUTOCAL
params.note: 0 = never overwrite the calibration with the learned bias. In-flight bias estimation and the boot gyro cal are unaffected.

heading-indoor.doc: Gyro-only heading indoors. Height and flow stay on the 4601 airframe defaults; EKF height tuning for auto takeoff is a separate change.

params.name: EKF2_MAG_TYPE
params.note: No magnetometer; heading from the gyro. On 003f001a (2026-11-23) the in-flight mag field test ratio hit 7.5 p95 / 20 max indoors with a clean 6-side cal, plus 'Strong magnetic interference'; at 5 the warning is gone.

tune-liion-4000.doc: PX4 autotune result, 2026-11-13, on the 6S 4000 mAh Li-ion pack strapped tight. The stock 4601 gains gave a pitch-only 8-9 Hz shake on battery (gyro std 3.7 deg/s pitch); autotuned: 2.0 deg/s. Unchanged from 4601: MC_ROLLRATE_D 0.001, all _FF and _K. MC_YAW_P stays at 4601's 2.8 on purpose: autotune clamps attitude P to 2.0-6.5 and returned the 6.5 ceiling, and yaw tracking was worse at it (rate error 1.8 vs 0.8 deg/s). Second aircraft 003f001a, 2026-11-23: roll/pitch gyro 2.0/2.8 -> 1.2/2.4 deg/s.

logging.doc: Log the estimator-replay topics too (bit 0 default + bit 1 EKF2 replay), so flow, rangefinder and EKF topics in a customer log are full rate instead of about 1 Hz. Logging still runs arm to disarm (SDLOG_MODE 0).

profiles.name: DEXI-5 Indoor (flow + rangefinder)
profiles.description: Autotuned gains, gyro-only heading and full-rate logging, layered on the 4601 airframe defaults (which already set flow + rangefinder navigation). Flight-validated on two DEXI-5s, 2026-11-13 and 2026-11-23.
details: Heading: gyro-only (EKF2_MAG_TYPE = 5); building steel corrupts the mag indoors
Tune: PX4 autotune on the 6S 4000 mAh Li-ion pack; rate gains about half of 4601
Logging: SDLOG_PROFILE 3 (adds EKF replay topics) for full-rate customer logs
